Several days (dozens of hours in total, with cooldowns and item gathering)

A big Kilmaresh quest in which you help the citizens of Issavi in seven independent missions: unmasking the {npc:Ambassador of Rathleton}, rituals with {npc:Kallimae}, the requests of the medusa {npc:Alyxo}, the ogres' revenge with {npc:Saideh}, {npc:Ninev}'s shark, {npc:Taya}'s oracle and the fugitives wanted by {npc:Eshaya}. At the end you put together the four pieces of the {item:The Regalia of Suon}, earn three parts of the {item:Sun Mosaic}, the {wiki:Citizen of Issavi Outfits|Citizen of Issavi Outfits}, the achievement **Sun and Sea** and access to the shortcuts to the south of Kilmaresh.
Explore Kilmaresh and help its citizens.
Eshaya, 2nd floor of the building north of the Issavi market
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 250+** (the whole island is full of strong creatures and there are several bosses and minibosses).
Team of up to 5 players for the boss {creature:Urmahlullu the Immaculate} (Fafnar's Wrath mission). The three outlaws from the Wanted mission must be killed **alone**.
The last part of the ogre mission (the sarcophagus) is only needed for those who have the {wiki:Grave Danger Quest} active; for this quest the first 4 puzzles are enough.
Access to {wiki:Krailos} (boat or tunnel in the Ruins of Nuur) for the Aspiring Oracle mission.
bought from Faloriel by asking for 'hallucinogen'
to get the Ivory Mask from the Ornamented Ankh in the library
for Veldt Flowers, Snake Maws, webs, roses and sheep wool
buy it at any tool shop (e.g. Tefrit)
to collect Ink from dead Biting Books
or {item:Obsidian Knife}, to scrape the mirror in the Wanted mission
optional, to catch the Small Tortoise at sea
Lots of potions and supplies: there are several bosses and many dangerous hunting places.
The Boards that Mean the World mission
The Revenge of the Ogres mission
Yonan puts the four pieces together
{wiki:Citizen of Issavi Outfits|Citizen of Issavi Outfits} (basic), Wanted mission
Permission to use the shortcuts between Issavi and southern Kilmaresh (Ruins of Nuur and Salt Caves)
Shortcut from the Nykri Delta to the Ruins of Nuur
After completing all the missions of the quest.
Shortcut from the south of Issavi to the Salt Caves
After completing all the missions of the quest.
The seven missions are independent: you can do them in parallel. Talk to all the NPCs right away to open the missions and keep collecting items while you hunt.
For the final reward ({item:The Regalia of Suon}) you need all four pieces: {item:Sun Medal}, {item:Blue and Golden Cordon}, {item:Sunray Emblem} and {item:Golden Bijou}.
{creature:Urmahlullu the Immaculate} has a 20-hour cooldown and {npc:Moe} takes 1 hour to steal the ring: plan around these waits.
Keep the {item:Ivory Mask} after the Fafnar's Wrath mission: it is needed again in the Wanted mission.
Don't hand in the Midnight Pilgrimage mission before getting the {item:Symbol of Sun and Sea} from the blood basin, if you want it (it's optional).
{npc:Eshaya} suspects the Ambassador of Rathleton is a traitor linked to the Fafnar cult. You have to find proof.

The whole quest takes place on the island of {wiki:Kilmaresh|Kilmaresh}, whose capital is **Issavi**. There are boats to Issavi from **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** and **Oramond**: talk to the port captain and say {key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat, in the harbour **north** of the city. Alternatively, come by magic carpet from any city with that service: you arrive at {npc:Tanyt}'s platform.

In Issavi, go to the **2nd floor** of the building north of the market and talk to {npc:Eshaya}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and accept with {key:yes}. He asks you to look for proof at the Ambassador's residence.
The Ambassador's house is on top of the city wall, **southeast** of Issavi.
Ambassador's house (on top of the wall)
Investigating the four spots in the house

Investigate, in this order: 1) the {item:Pile of Scrolls (Ambassador)|Pile of Scrolls} on the first floor of the house; 2) the {item:Half Burnt Scroll} on the second floor; 3) the {item:Torn Piece of Paper} also on the second floor; 4) walk around the **roof**. At the end you get a message saying you found nothing.

Go back to {npc:Eshaya} and say {key:mission}. Since there is no proof, he wants you to see the Ambassador's memories with a {item:Ring of Secret Thoughts}, which is in the possession of the monster **Urmahlullu**.

Go to the cave **south** of the city and enter the boss room (team of up to 5 players). You have to kill the five forms in a row: {creature:Urmahlullu the Immaculate}, {creature:Wildness of Urmahlullu}, {creature:Urmahlullu the Tamed}, {creature:Wisdom of Urmahlullu} and finally {creature:Urmahlullu the Weakened}. All participants receive a {item:Ring of Secret Thoughts} every time they defeat the boss, until they finish this mission.

The fight is simple but long: three of the five forms have a lot of HP. The 4th form ({creature:Wisdom of Urmahlullu}) attacks from range and runs away from the team if it isn't cornered. It is recommended to trap the boss next to the exit teleport or in the southwest corner.
Killing the boss is not mandatory: if you get the {item:Ring of Secret Thoughts} some other way (e.g. bought), just hand it in. The room can only be re-entered after **20 hours**.

After killing the last form, leave through the **exit teleport** of the boss room (the same one next to which it is advisable to trap the boss). Then head back **north**, the same way through the Green Belt, to Issavi.
Giving the ring to the Ambassador
Find the {npc:Ambassador of Rathleton} inside the **Library** and give him the {item:Ring of Secret Thoughts}. He gladly accepts it.
Asking the thief Moe for help

To get the ring back you need a thief. Go **two floors up** in the building north of the market and talk to {npc:Moe}: {key:hi}, {key:thief}. He asks for 10 {item:Sphinx Feather|Sphinx Feathers}. Hand them over (it appears in the Quest Log as the separate mission *Gifts for Moe*).
Moe needs time to steal the ring: wait **1 hour**. Then come back and ask again about {key:thief} or {key:ring}. You get the {item:Ring of Secret Thoughts (Charged)}.
Go to the library and talk to {npc:The Librarian}: {key:hi}, {key:ring}. He explains that you need a {item:Flask of Hallucinogen}, sold by {npc:Faloriel}.
Talk to {npc:Faloriel}, the potion seller, and specifically ask for {key:hallucinogen} to buy the {item:Flask of Hallucinogen}.
You can buy several flasks and give them to players who have already done the mission: that way they can enter the Ambassador's mind again to help you.

Go to the **Temple of Bastesh** (building to the south, on the west side of the city). **Equip** the {item:Ring of Secret Thoughts (Charged)} and use the {item:Flask of Hallucinogen} on yourself. You are sent to the {wiki:Ambassador's Mind|Ambassador's Mind}.
The mind has two sides and each player can be sent to either one, apparently at random. The team may end up split and will have to regroup through the {item:Mirror Neuron|Mirror Neurons}.

Kill the {creature:Earworm|Earworms} (strength similar to the other Kilmaresh creatures) and collect three shards: {item:Green Memory Shard|green}, {item:Violet Memory Shard|violet} and {item:Blue Memory Shard|blue}. Each player needs **one of each**.
Use the Mirror Neurons to cross from one side to the other
**Don't step on the energy fields**: if you do, one of the shards in your backpack disappears.

With the three shards, go to the **left (west)** side of the map, where the {item:Memory Enlightener} (a Fire Basin) is. Use one shard of each colour on it. Then find the way back to the exit teleport.
Don't lose the shards on the way back: you will still need them to talk to the Empress.

Go back to the mind's **exit teleport** and step into it to return to Kilmaresh, still with the three Memory Shards in your backpack. There is no other way in: to go back in you always need a new {item:Flask of Hallucinogen} and the charged ring. After you finish the quest, you can only get another flask if someone with the mission open buys it for you.
Go back to {npc:Eshaya} and say {key:mission}. He tells you to report to {npc:The Empress}.

Talk to {npc:The Empress} (say {key:hi}) with the **three Memory Shards in your backpack**. She confirms that the Ambassador is a traitor and gives you a {item:Sceptre of Sun and Sea} to bless five Fafnar statues in the catacombs.
2. Fafnar's Wrath — One last favor (the catacomb statues)

To get around the {wiki:Kilmaresh Catacombs|Kilmaresh Catacombs} you need four masks; each one opens a set of doors. The {item:Secret Instruction} documents explain where they are, but they are not needed.

The {item:Mirror Mask} is in a coffin, in a dungeon beneath the **Central Steppe**. It opens the first door next to the main entrance of the catacombs. The entrance is on the Central Steppe, **southwest** of Issavi, almost in the same spot as the tomb of {creature:Enusat the Onyx Wing}. After you get the mask, return to the surface the same way.
The {item:Ivory Mask} is obtained in the **Library**, by using a {item:Small Emerald} on the Ornamented Ankh there. It opens the doors that give access to the centre from the **south**.
Keep the Ivory Mask: you will need it again in the Wanted mission.

The {item:Silver Mask} is on a tree, on the small island **west** of the Central Steppe. It opens the doors that give access to the centre from the **north**. After you get it, go back the same way to the Central Steppe.

The {item:Gryphon Mask} is in a {item:Gryphon Nest} at the top of the {wiki:Kilmaresh Mountains|Kilmaresh Mountains}. It opens the door of the small room south of the main area. The nest is at the highest point of the mountain (4 floors above ground); then go back down the same way.

The {wiki:Kilmaresh Catacombs|Kilmaresh Catacombs} are beneath the **west** side of Issavi and are linked to the **Nykri Delta** by a series of tunnels with an exit on the steppe. The safest entrance is from the **north**, through the cave of the {creature:Sphinx|Sphinxes} and {creature:Crypt Warden|Crypt Wardens}. The mask doors are **two floors below** ground; the Mirror Mask one is the first, next to the main entrance.
Mirror Mask door (next to the main entrance)
Silver Mask doors (access from the north)

With the {item:Sceptre of Sun and Sea} in hand, go down into the catacombs and make your way to the five {item:Statue of Fafnar (Meditating)|Statues of Fafnar}. Use the sceptre on each of them. The safest route starts in the **north**, entering through the {creature:Sphinx|Sphinxes}/{creature:Crypt Warden|Crypt Wardens} cave.
The catacombs are full of {creature:Priestess of the Wild Sun|Priestesses of the Wild Sun}, {creature:Burning Gladiator|Burning Gladiators} and other strong creatures.
After the fifth statue, go back the same way to the cave you came in through and go up to the surface (or follow the tunnels to the exit at the Nykri Delta). Then return to Issavi.
Go back to {npc:The Empress} after blessing the five statues. You receive the {item:Sun Medal}, the first piece of the Regalia of Suon.
Go **two floors up** in the building just east of the depot and talk to {npc:Kallimae}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. She needs ingredients for magic rituals.
Before collecting the ingredients you need these tools:
In a box, in a small house near the harbour, at {coord:33898,31477,7}
Buy it at any tool shop: in Issavi ({npc:Tefrit}) or other cities
Loot from cultists in the {wiki:Issavi Sewers|Issavi Sewers}, {wiki:Kilmaresh Catacombs|Kilmaresh Catacombs} and {wiki:Kilmaresh Mountains|Kilmaresh Mountains}
Given by {npc:Yonan} when you ask him for the list
Talk to {npc:Yonan}, {npc:Narsai}, {npc:Shimun} and {npc:Tefrit} and ask each one for {key:mission}. Each gives you a list of ingredients.
Tefrit (hidden at the top of the mountain)
Collect everything on the four lists:
Use the {item:Pick (Enchanted)} on {item:Veined Stone|Veined Stones}. The pick has 3 uses and then loses its enchantment: wait 5 minutes for it to recharge
Use an {item:Empty Honey Glass} on {item:Honey Palm|Honey Palms}
Use a {item:Vial} on a dead {creature:Biting Book} (there are two beneath the Kilmaresh library)
Use the {item:Bark Peeler} on {item:Honey Palm|Honey Palms}
When you have everything, hand the ingredients in to each respective NPC ({npc:Yonan}, {npc:Narsai}, {npc:Shimun} and {npc:Tefrit}).
Kallimae asks you for the Midnight Pilgrimage: finding four Omens that Bastesh herself announced.
Go back to {npc:Kallimae} and say {key:mission} to receive the Midnight Pilgrimage.
Inside the Kilmaresh Catacombs, find the {item:Basin Filled with Blood} and use it. Message: *"You find a golden symbol at the bottom of the blood-filled basin."*
Omen 2: the basin filled with blood
If you click the basin **with no ring equipped**, you get a {item:Symbol of Sun and Sea}. It isn't needed for the quest, but it can no longer be obtained after you hand in this mission.
Head well **east** of the Southern Steppe, find the {creature:Sun-Marked Goanna} and kill it to get the {item:Goanna Hide with Sun Symbol}.
Sun-Marked Goanna (east of the Southern Steppe)

In the **west** part of the Green Belt, next to the mountain, find the {item:Bloodspot} on a {item:Sequoia Trunk} hit by an arrow. Message: *"You discover an arrow sticking in a tree. Mysteriously, fresh blood is trickling from the spot where the arrow hit the trunk."*
Go back to {npc:Kallimae} and report the mission. You receive the {item:Blue and Golden Cordon}.
Find the medusa {npc:Alyxo} **northeast** of the depot and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}. First you have to kill three summoned demons.
{creature:Bragrumol} is in a cave on the **Central Steppe**: go down and kill it. After killing it, go back up the same way.
{creature:Xogixath} is in a small cave in the **Nykri Delta**. Go down **one floor** to find it and go back up the same way.
{creature:Mozradek} is in a small cave **northeast** of Issavi, on the second floor. It is **two floors below** the entrance; leave the same way.
Go back to {npc:Alyxo} and ask for {key:mission}. She gives you three assignments: kill 300 cultists, find a gift for {npc:Narsai} and recover the {item:Ivory Lyre}.
Kill 300 {wiki:Fafnar Cultists|Fafnar Cultists} in the Kilmaresh Catacombs, the Issavi Sewers or the Kilmaresh Mountain.
Only {creature:Priestess of the Wild Sun|Priestesses of the Wild Sun} and {creature:Burning Gladiator|Burning Gladiators} count.

The gift for {npc:Narsai} is a {item:Small Tortoise}. You get it as loot from {creature:Young Goanna|Young Goannas} or by using a {item:Net (Fishing)|Net} in the sea of Kilmaresh (it takes several tries).
Talk to {npc:Moe} and ask him about the {key:ivory lyre}: he tells you where it is and gives you permission to open the locked door.
The {item:Ivory Lyre} is **two floors below** the cave where you killed {creature:Xogixath}, in the Nykri Delta. Go and get it. Then go back up the two floors the same way.
Go back to {npc:Alyxo} and hand in each assignment **separately**, saying {key:fafnar cultists}, {key:small tortoise} and {key:lyre}. Then say {key:mission}. You receive the {item:Sunray Emblem}.

To finish Saideh's mission you only need the first 4 puzzles. Puzzles 5 and 6 only serve to open the last floor as a hunting place and for a mission of the {wiki:Grave Danger Quest}, but you might as well do them all.

Go around via the Central and Southern Steppe to the **west** side of the Green Belt and enter the Kilmaresh Mountain. Swim in the river and pass **behind the waterfall**, where {npc:Saideh} is. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}: she wants you to rebury the remains of the hero Dayyan, crossing a dungeon full of puzzles.
Enter the cave and go down one floor. Find the {item:Wooden Cage Key} in the **west** part of the cave.
Head **southeast** and use the key here to open the passage. You get permanent access, but the key is destroyed.
Where to use the Wooden Cage Key
Go down the stairs, follow the path **north** and enter the small room to the **west** with 4 {item:Magic Forcefield|Magic Forcefields} (teleports).
Each teleport has an item representing one of the four vocations. Enter the teleport matching your vocation.
If you use the wrong teleport you are sent to the surface of the Green Belt.

There are three Fire Basins that light up and go out, and 4 teleports. Enter the teleport that matches the **number of basins lit at that moment**, from 0 to 3 left to right: the leftmost teleport when they are all out, the rightmost when they are all lit.
Puzzle 2: the three basins and the four teleports

Another room with 4 teleports. To the south there is a small room with two {creature:Mummy|Mummies} and black stripes on the floor, each one matching a teleport. Enter the teleport whose stripe has **at least one mummy on top** at that moment.
Puzzle 3: the black stripes and the mummies

There are 4 rows of different tiles that you have to cross. To the south of them are 4 tiles that show the safe tile of each row: the first from the left matches the 1st row, the second the 2nd, and so on. Recommended strategy: cross the 1st row first, wait for the pattern to change, quickly memorise the tiles of the 2nd, 3rd and 4th rows and run across them.
Each tile to the south matches a row you have to cross
This would be the path for the pattern that appeared
Follow the path **west** to a big room with a {item:Scorpion Grave}. Use the **left side** of the grave to get a message and the Quest Log update.
The Scorpion Grave that Saideh asked you to check
If you use the **right side** of the Scorpion Grave you take fire damage equal to 50% of your total HP. Careful, especially if you haven't killed the creatures in the room yet.

Head **west** and then **south**. There are two rectangles with the same types of tile as the previous puzzle, which keep changing, and one teleport for each type of tile. Enter the teleport of the tile type that appears **in the greatest number** at that moment.
Puzzle 5: the two rectangles and the teleports

Cross the maze stepping on **all** the Sparkles that close off the small rooms, **without passing twice** over any of them. If you make a mistake, red musical notes appear on your character and you have to use the lever on the **west** side of the room to start over. Several routes are possible; one is in the image.
Puzzle 6: a possible route through the maze
After the puzzles, go down to the floor below and use the {item:Vial of Potent Holy Water} on the sarcophagus.
This part is only needed for the {wiki:Grave Danger Quest}. If you don't have that quest open, they won't let you go down.

When you are done (Scorpion Grave and, if you want, puzzles 5 and 6), go back the same way to the stairs, go up to the floor of the {item:Wooden Cage Key} (the cage stays open for good) and leave the cave to the waterfall, where {npc:Saideh} is. Remember that entering a wrong teleport in puzzle 1 puts you on the surface of the Green Belt.
Cage opened with the Wooden Cage Key
Handing in the mission to Saideh
Go back to {npc:Saideh} behind the waterfall and report the mission. You receive the {item:Golden Bijou}.
In the Temple of Bastesh, talk to {npc:Ninev}: {key:hi}, {key:shark}. You have to gather materials for a medicine for the sick shark.
The {item:Box with Balm} is just **north** of the exit next to the boat.
Use {item:Scissors} on a live {creature:Sheep|sheep} to get {item:Greasy Wool}. There are sheep in the **west** of the Nykri Delta.
Use the {item:Greasy Wool} on the {item:Box with Balm} to create the {item:Box with Waterproof Balm}.
Hand the {item:Box with Waterproof Balm} to {npc:Ninev}. You receive a {item:Golden Sea Horse Figurine}.
Go back to Issavi and talk to {npc:Narsai}, just south of the market: {key:hi}, {key:oracle}. You have to find the two parts of the Eye of Suon: a golden frame and a red gem.

Go to the {wiki:Salt Caves|Salt Caves}, south of Issavi. The {item:Eye-Shaped Frame} is inside the **Floating Cask** in the centre of the cave. The cave is **one floor below** the entrance. To leave, go back the same way to the entrance south of Issavi.
The Salt Caves are full of {creature:Bashmu} and {creature:Juvenile Bashmu}.

At the Issavi harbour, talk to {npc:Captain Harava} and say {key:hi}, {key:krailos}, {key:yes} (80 gp). You arrive at the {wiki:Krailos} harbour, next to {npc:Captain Pelagia}. The {wiki:Krailos Ruins|Krailos Ruins} are in the **northwest** of Krailos. According to {npc:Narsai}, there is also a secret tunnel in the Ruins of Nuur that connects to Krailos, with a sealed door that opens by drawing a sun symbol on the door, above the handle.

Travel to {wiki:Krailos} (by boat, or the secret tunnel in the Ruins of Nuur) and enter the {wiki:Krailos Ruins|Krailos Ruins} ({creature:Nightmare Scion|Nightmare Scions} cave). Go to the second floor and take the {item:Red Gem (Eye)} from the sarcophagus.
Go up the two floors the same way and leave the Krailos Ruins. At the Krailos harbour talk to {npc:Captain Pelagia} and say {key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes} to go back to the Issavi harbour.
Use the gem on the frame to create {item:The Eye of Suon}. Message: *"You put together the bright red gem and the golden frame. The Eye of Suon is restored."*
Say {key:oracle} to {npc:Narsai}. You receive an Old Parchment with the names of 7 sphinxes and lamassu and a bottle of {item:Sacramental Wine}.
Offering the wine to the 7 statues

Equip {item:The Eye of Suon} in the **necklace** slot and use the {item:Sacramental Wine} next to each of the seven statues. At each one you get the message *"You pour out the sacramental wine in front of [name]'s statue."* Three statues are underground: Yaeta in the Kilmaresh Catacombs (enter as in the Fafnar statues mission), Rimush in the Ruins of Nuur (beneath Kilmaresh, to the south) and Anunit in a tomb beneath the Nykri Delta. From each one, return to the surface the same way.
West of the city, near the Sphinxes and Lamassu
Ruins of Nuur, in a room on the east side
In a tomb beneath the Nykri Delta
Talk to {npc:Narsai} ({key:oracle}): she confirms you have offered all the sacrifices. Then go back to {npc:Taya} and say {key:oracle}. She asks you to kill Enusat the Onyx Wing.
{creature:Enusat the Onyx Wing} is in a tomb beneath the **Central Steppe**. Kill him. Then go back up the same way to the steppe.
Go back to {npc:Taya} and say {key:oracle}. You receive the three parts of the {item:Sun Mosaic}.
Three parts of the Sun Mosaic
Talk to {npc:Eshaya} north of the market: {key:hi}, {key:wanted} and {key:yes}. There are four wanted criminals (Amenef, Neferi, Petaris and Hetai), but one of them may be innocent.
Go to {npc:Kallimae} (east of the depot) and say {key:wanted}. She explains the ritual: a **golden** hand mirror, blackened by fire, scraped at the Suon shrine while you wear an ivory mask.
Get back the {item:Ivory Mask} from the earlier missions, or get a new one (Small Emerald on the Ornamented Ankh in the library).

Go to the {wiki:Ruins of Nuur|Ruins of Nuur} and take the {item:Golden Hand Mirror} from an {item:Ornate Case} in a small room to the **east**. The {wiki:Ruins of Nuur|Ruins of Nuur} are beneath Kilmaresh, **south** of Issavi; leave the same way you came in.
Ornate Case with the Golden Hand Mirror
Use the mirror on a {item:Fire Bowl} anywhere in Issavi. It turns into a {item:Blackened Hand Mirror}.
Perform the ritual at the shrine

Go to Nykri Delta, where {npc:Taya} is, and climb up to the shrine. **Equip the {item:Ivory Mask}** and use your {item:Secret Agent Tool} or {item:Obsidian Knife} on the blackened mirror. Message: *"A young woman's face appears in the mirror and a voice seems to whisper into your ear: 'Petaris is innocent.'"*
If you do not have the mask equipped, or if you scrape the mirror away from the altar, you have to blacken it in the fire again.
Go back to {npc:Eshaya} and say {key:wanted}. Now you have to defeat the other three outlaws.
The three outlaws are minibosses that you have to kill **solo**. Each one has a portal:
In the centre of the Kilmaresh Catacombs, {coord:33883,31468,9}
Inside the Ruins of Nuur, to the south, {coord:33819,31773,10}

After each fight, leave the outlaw's room and go back the same way: Neferi's portal is next to the Issavi boat (you are already in the city); for Sister Hetai's, leave the Kilmaresh Catacombs as in the statues mission; for Amenef's, climb up from the Ruins of Nuur the same way you came down.
After killing all three, go back to {npc:Eshaya} and report. You receive the {wiki:Citizen of Issavi Outfits|Citizen of Issavi Outfits} (basic).

With the four pieces in your backpack ({item:Blue and Golden Cordon}, {item:Golden Bijou}, {item:Sunray Emblem} and {item:Sun Medal}), talk to {npc:Yonan} in the market: {key:hi}, {key:the regalia of suon} and {key:yes}. He combines the pieces into {item:The Regalia of Suon}.

After completing all the missions, you can use the two shortcuts near Issavi: from **Nykri Delta** to the {wiki:Ruins of Nuur|Ruins of Nuur}, and from **south of Issavi** to the {wiki:Salt Caves|Salt Caves}.
Exit in the Ruins of Nuur

To leave the island, go to the Issavi harbour and talk to {npc:Captain Harava}: say {key:hi}, the destination ({key:darashia}, {key:venore}, {key:krailos} or {key:oramond}) and {key:yes}. You can also use {npc:Tanyt}'s magic carpet.
The **Wanted** and **Aspiring Oracle** missions were added in the Summer Update 2021.
The {item:Symbol of Sun and Sea} (from the blood basin in the catacombs) is optional and can only be picked up before you hand in Midnight Pilgrimage, and only with no ring equipped.
After finishing Fafnar's Wrath, you can give {item:Flask of Hallucinogen|Flasks of Hallucinogen} to friends who have already done it so they can go with you to the Ambassador's Mind again.
